Confirm the default compiler refuses pending candidates, intermediate states grant no composition mastery, assisted completion remains ineligible, and unassisted complete compositions follow existing mastery rules only inside the declared inspection scope.

native_review.interpretation: Pending candidates and unchanged legacy graphs are inspection-only. Default compiler and resolver rejection protect live approval. Inspection bypass can set syntactic mastery flags for complete unassisted multipart graphs; it does not grant production mastery or review approval. Atomic and partial tiles cannot earn composition mastery.
